identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit: 'Alliance For A Healthier Generation Inc', EIN 27-2028308 (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer); the organization brands itself 'Healthier Generation' (healthiergeneration.org)
Third-party nonprofit profile (Cause IQ) lists the organization at Portland, OR, matching the agenda's 'Portland, OR'

Website describes work with schools and districts on children's physical, social and emotional health, matching OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' category and a Community Schools and Student Services MOU; the organization has California school and district partners
research.notes: Address and headquarters intentionally left blank: the organization's own contact page gives a Washington, D.C. mailing address (1629 K St. N.W. Suite 300), while Cause IQ lists 1028 SE Water Ave 210, Portland, OR 97214 and the agenda says Portland, OR. The only email on the contact page is give@healthiergeneration.org, a donations inbox, so it was not used. No page found confirms the specific smart-thermometer MOU; identity rests on name, nonprofit registry, Portland location and school-health mission. California Secretary of State and SAM.gov were not checked.

profile.legalName: Alliance For A Healthier Generation Inc
profile.summary: A national nonprofit that works with schools, youth organizations, businesses and communities to support children's physical, social and emotional health. Its work includes expanding access to nutritious foods, physical activity, social-emotional support and tobacco-free spaces.

sources.title: Alliance For A Healthier Generation Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: ProPublica confirms the 501(c)(3) Alliance For A Healthier Generation Inc, EIN 27-2028308, and the about-us page supports the summary and phone 1-888-543-4584. The org describes itself as virtual with staff nationwide, so a Portland, OR presence is plausible, and its school-health mission fits a no-cost Community Schools smart-thermometer MOU; address and headquarters were rightly left null.
